# rustinion_group_log_collection (Resource)

Manages a group's device log collection: on/off (`enabled`, default true), `min_severity` (default warning), `kernel_min_severity`, `windows_channels`, `windows_always` (event IDs collected at any level), `files` ([{path, service, multiline_start, min_severity}]), `containers` ({enabled, include, exclude, min_severity}), `syslog` ({enabled, udp_port, tcp_port, tls_port, tls_cert_path, tls_key_path}), `max_lines_per_minute`, `buffer_max_mb`. Absent keys use the built-in defaults. Destroying the resource restores the defaults (collection on).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `settings_json` (String) The settings as a JSON object (jsonencode). Validated by the server.
- `target_id` (String) The group id.

### Read-Only

- `effective_json` (String) What the group's devices actually run with (defaults and inheritance applied).
- `id` (String) Same as target_id.
